Normalized triangle side fractions admit the uniform and (1/2,1/2,0) majorization extrema. Beta integrals give the exact moment law, \(m_1=e_2/2,\ m_2=e_2/6,\ m_3=3e_2/40-e_3/60\); m1,m3 reconstruct the roots of \(x^3-x^2+e_2x-e_3\). Exact rational checks and independent geometric Monte Carlo ran successfully; numerical checks are supplementary.

value.rationale: Determining which triangle shapes maximize every normalized random-inscribed-area exceedance probability is a natural exact stochastic geometry problem. The strict Schur-majorization theorem is simultaneously sharp at all thresholds and provides an unattained geometric degeneration boundary. The area law fully reconstructs a triangle up to similarity from just two moments despite universal redundancy of the second moment; this is a nontrivial inverse geometric distinction between total-arclength and affine-equivariant forced-edge sampling.
